designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one opaque landscape 16:9 pixel-art background for a 2D side scrolling action platformer. Pentagon exterior at dusk, broad low limestone military headquarters facade, angular architectural wings, flagpoles, distant entry pavilion, lawn and dark pavement, muted olive stone and amber window lights. Handcrafted coarse pixel art, visible square pixels, dark crisp outlines, limited colors matching dark atmospheric indie pixel action game. Flat SIDE-ON composition. All architecture and furniture behind gameplay. Bottom 25 percent low-detail open dark floor for tiny combat sprites. No people, enemies, UI, readable text, watermark, panels, floating platforms or foreground obstacles. Not a real interior layout or blueprint; fictional game environment.
